text: @ruqinhu/dsh-memory 是面向 DSH 的长期记忆插件，通过服务入口接入动态系统提示上下文，并注册工具读写 MEMORY.md 与 USER.md。文档较小时会整体注入提示，超过 6,000 字符则提供条目索引，供后续搜索和读取。用户可查看字符用量、追加或替换条目，并通过维护工具查看备份和使用情况；写入超过各文档上限时会被拒绝。适合希望在 DSH 会话间保留规则与用户偏好、并按需管理记忆的用户。默认在本机 ~/.dsh/memory 保存文档和备份，可配置目录及字符上限。

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory adds DSH memory by injecting MEMORY.md and USER.md into prompt context. Above 6,000 combined characters, it supplies a search index. Tools read and update entries, and reject writes over the caps. Documents and backups stay in a configurable local directory.
我想让 DSH 在不同会话里记住长期规则和我的偏好。
Help me search and maintain saved DSH memory without exceeding a fixed character budget.
@ruqinhu/dsh-memory 的功能「记忆上下文注入」：自动把两份记忆文档加入 DSH 提示上下文；合计超过 6,000 字符时改为注入索引，供搜索和读取。可通过配置关闭。

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · @ruqinhu/dsh-memory：English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Long-term memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
two §-delimited documents, a hard character budget, and content-derived ids that make
the index navigable.

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 1. The constraint：| Constraint | Consequence |
| --- | --- |
| Memory is prompt context, paid on every request | both documents carry a hard cap |
| A truncated rule is a rule silently lost | over-cap writes are **rejected**, never truncated |
| The cap forces deletion | deletion needs evidence, so usage is counted |

| Document | Default cap | Holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MEMORY.md` | 2,200 chars | durable rules |
| `USER.md` | 1,375 chars | owner profile and standing preferences |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 1. The constraint：Reference failure: the inherited Hermes deployment reached 3,687/2,200 (68% over) and
2,748/1,375 (100% over) with nothing noticing.

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 2. Mechanisms：| Problem | Decision | Rejected alternative | Cost paid |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| How much to inject | ≤ 6,000 chars combined → whole documents inline; above → index of ids + first lines | always inline: crowds out working context; always index: every small deployment pays a round trip | index mode costs one tool call |
| What an entry is called | id = hash(target, text), 10 hex, prefix `m-`/`u-` | positional ids (`entry 7`) renumber on every compression, silently re-pointing every reference | editing a rule invalidates its id (intended) |
| How to read one rule | `memory_get(id)`; `memory_search` returns ids too | 80-character headlines only: reading the rest means guessing keywords | one more tool |
| How to match CJK | bigrams (`止损怎么设` → `止损`/`损怎`/`么设`), ASCII words ≥2 chars | whole runs: `止损怎么设` scored **0** against `止损 2.96` — recall silently empty | single characters still not split (too broad) |
| How much recall injects | 1,500-char budget, highest score first, entries that do not fit are **skipped** | truncating: half a rule reads like a complete one | a query can return nothing when one rule is too large |
| Where usage evide

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 2. Mechanisms：Registration is a deferred child fiber (`ctx.inject(['skills'])`), not a `static
inject` entry — a plugin that requires a skill registry refuses to load without one.

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 3. Failure modes：| Failure | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Write exceeds the cap | rejected with current/cap; forces a compression pass |
| `memory_get` on a stale id | answers "call `memory_search`" instead of resolving to a different rule |
| Recall throws | swallowed; a recall failure never fails the turn |
| Profile has no skill registry | registration skipped, plugin loads normally |
| Sidecar is corrupt | treated as empty and rebuilt from the documents on the next sync |
| Automatic recall fires every turn | sidecar writes are coalesced to one a minute |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 4. Measured：| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Unit tests | 118 across 15 files; `tsc --noEmit` clean under `strict` |
| Live round trip | `memory_search("网关")` → `m-efa7252010`; `memory_get` returned the full 95-char entry; `hits` reached 2 |
| Skill registration | `memory-curation` present in the live agent's catalog |
| Live shape | 38 entries against a raised 3,000-char cap, still inside the 6,000 inlining threshold |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 5. Open questions：| Question | Current state |
| --- | --- |
| Automatic recall | off by default; pays only after injection switches to an index |
| `snapshot()` | returns live records, not copies — misleading name, tests mutate through it |
| Cold list | a 12-entry sample, not an inventory |
| Editing a rule | resets its statistics (intended, but hides usage history) |
| Cross-document duplicates | not detected; the same rule in both documents counts twice |
| Cap unit | characters, not tokens — re-measure when switching language |
| Cross-device sharing | none; no locking story |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 6. Compatibility：| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.2.2-rc.1` (peer dependencies pinned) |
| Runtime | Node 22+, no native modules |
| Runtime dependencies | `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` only |
| Optional integration | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` — absent means no skill, not no plugin |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 7. Install and configure：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryCap` | `2200` | `MEMORY.md` cap |
| `userCap` | `1375` | `USER.md` cap |
| `enableInjection` | `true` | inject as dynamic prompt context |
| `backupKeep` | `12` | backup directories retained |
| `memoryDir` | `~/.dsh/memory` | documents and backups |
| `enableRecall` | `false` | register `memory_recall` |
| `enableAutoRecall` | `false` | recall once per turn |
| `recallBudgetChars` | `1500` | ceiling for one recall |
| `staleAfterDays` | `45` | unused this long → cold |
| `staleMinAgeDays` | `14` | never report younger entries as unused |
| `enableSkill` | `true` | register `memory-curation` when a registry exists |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 8. Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_read` | read a document with usage and entry count |
| `memory_get` | read one entry in full by id |
| `memory_search` | keyword search; returns scored matches with ids |
| `memory_recall` | search and render a ready-to-use block (`enableRecall`) |
| `memory_write` | replace a document (rejected over cap) |
| `memory_append` | append one entry (rejected over cap) |
| `memory_replace` | replace an exact substring in place — the compression primitive |
| `memory_maintenance` | back up, rotate, report usage, list cold entries |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 8. Tools：Weekly pass: point a scheduled task at `memory_maintenance`, then merge or drop
entries with `memory_replace` until usage is back under cap.

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 1. 约束：| 约束 | 后果 |
| --- | --- |
| 记忆是提示上下文，每次请求都付费 | 两份文档都有硬性上限 |
| 被截断的规则等于被悄悄丢掉的规则 | 超限写入**拒绝**，绝不截断 |
| 上限逼着必须删 | 删要有证据，所以统计用量 |

| 文档 | 默认上限 | 存什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MEMORY.md` | 2,200 字符 | 长期规则 |
| `USER.md` | 1,375 字符 | owner 画像与长期偏好 |

反面案例：参照的 Hermes 部署涨到 3,687/2,200（超 68%）与 2,748/1,375（超 100%），无人察觉。

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 2. 机制：| 问题 | 决定 | 否决的替代 | 代价 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 注入多少 | 合计 ≤ 6,000 字符整份内联；超过则只注入索引（ID + 首行） | 一直内联会挤占工作上下文；一直索引让小部署白付一次往返 | 索引模式多一次工具调用 |
| 条目叫什么 | ID = hash(目标, 正文) 取十位十六进制，前缀 `m-`/`u-` | 位置编号（`第 7 条`）每次压缩都重排，旧引用静默指向别的规则 | 规则被改则 ID 失效（有意） |
| 怎么读回一条 | `memory_get(id)`；`memory_search` 也返回 ID | 只给 80 字首行：想读完全文只能猜关键词 | 多一个工具 |
| 中文怎么匹配 | 二元组（`止损怎么设` → `止损`/`损怎`/`么设`），ASCII 词 ≥2 字符 | 整段保留：`止损怎么设` 对 `止损 2.96` 得 **0 分**，召回静默为空 | 单字仍不切（太宽泛） |
| 召回注入多少 | 1,500 字符预算，高分优先，放不下的条目**跳过** | 截断：半条规则读起来像完整的 | 某条太大时可能一条都放不下 |
| 用量证据在哪 | 侧车 `.entry-index.json`：`hits`、`firstSeenAt`、`lastHitAt` | 凭感觉压缩：删掉仍有效的、留下死规则 | 内联注入的条目永不计数 —— 证据只是下界 |
| 何时算「没用」 | 维护报告列出 45 天未命中、年龄 ≥14 天、最多 12 条，按字符数降序 | 全量列出：没人读的清单 | 是抽样，不是清单 |
| 写作纪律放哪 | `memory-curation` 技能，仅当 profile 有技能注册表时注册 | 每请求注入协议：用上下文讲「怎么写上下文」 | 没有注册表就没有技能 |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 2. 机制：注册走延迟子 fiber（`ctx.inject(['skills'])`），不是 `static inject` —— 把注册表写成必需依赖，
会让没有它的 profile 整个插件都加载不起来。

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 3. 失败模式：| 失败 | 现在的行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 写入超上限 | 拒绝并报当前值/上限，逼一次压缩 |
| 对过期 ID 调 `memory_get` | 回答「请调用 `memory_search`」，而不是解析成另一条规则 |
| 召回抛错 | 吞掉；召回失败绝不让回合失败 |
| profile 没有技能注册表 | 跳过注册，插件照常加载 |
| 侧车文件损坏 | 当空处理，下次同步从文档重建 |
| 自动召回每回合触发 | 侧车写入合并为每分钟最多一次 |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 4. 实测：| 项 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 单测 | 118 个、15 个文件；`tsc --noEmit` 在 `strict` 下干净 |
| 线上往返 | `memory_search("网关")` → `m-efa7252010`；`memory_get` 拿回完整 95 字条目；`hits` 到 2 |
| 技能注册 | 线上 agent 的技能目录里有 `memory-curation` |
| 线上形态 | 38 条条目、上限调到 3,000 字符，仍在 6,000 内联阈值内 |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 5. 开放问题：| 问题 | 现状 |
| --- | --- |
| 自动召回 | 默认关；只有注入转为索引后才有价值 |
| `snapshot()` | 返回活记录而非副本，命名误导；测试通过它改状态 |
| 冷清单 | 12 条抽样，不是清单 |
| 改写条目 | 统计清零（有意，但藏掉用量历史） |
| 跨文档重复 | 不检测；同一规则出现在两份文档算两条 |
| 上限单位 | 字符而非 token —— 换语言要重新量 |
| 跨设备共享 | 无，也没有加锁方案 |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 6. 兼容性：| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.2.2-rc.1`（peer 依赖按此钉住） |
| 运行时 | Node 22+，无原生模块 |
| 运行时依赖 | 只有 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` |
| 可选集成 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` —— 缺失只是没有技能，不是插件不加载 |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 7. 安装与配置：| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryCap` | `2200` | `MEMORY.md` 上限 |
| `userCap` | `1375` | `USER.md` 上限 |
| `enableInjection` | `true` | 是否作为动态上下文注入 |
| `backupKeep` | `12` | 保留的备份目录数 |
| `memoryDir` | `~/.dsh/memory` | 文档与备份目录 |
| `enableRecall` | `false` | 是否注册 `memory_recall` |
| `enableAutoRecall` | `false` | 是否每回合自动召回 |
| `recallBudgetChars` | `1500` | 单次召回上限 |
| `staleAfterDays` | `45` | 多久未用算冷条目 |
| `staleMinAgeDays` | `14` | 年轻于此天数永不报为未使用 |
| `enableSkill` | `true` | 有注册表时注册 `memory-curation` |

@ruqinhu/dsh-memory README · 8. 工具：| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_read` | 读文档，含用量与条目数 |
| `memory_get` | 按 ID 读单条全文 |
| `memory_search` | 关键词检索，返回带 ID 的得分结果 |
| `memory_recall` | 检索并排版成可直接使用的块（`enableRecall`） |
| `memory_write` | 整体替换（超上限拒绝） |
| `memory_append` | 追加一条（超上限拒绝） |
| `memory_replace` | 精确替换子串 —— 压缩原语 |
| `memory_maintenance` | 备份、轮转、报告用量、列冷条目 |

每周维护：把定时任务指向 `memory_maintenance`，再用 `memory_replace` 合并或删除条目，直到
用量回到上限内。
